title: Skill package
description: The install-layout contract for one directory under skills/. This file is documentation: the enforcer is scripts/validate_skills.py (stdlib only), which applies the required-file, naming, and semver rules below. Keep the two in sync when the layout changes.

dir.description: Directory name under skills/. Must equal the SKILL.md frontmatter `name`.

SKILL.md.description: Required. Markdown with a leading YAML frontmatter block (--- fenced) that agents load.

name.description: Skill name; must equal the directory name.

description.description: Non-empty. When to load the skill, including trigger phrases.

argument-hint.description: Optional. Shown next to slash commands.

README.md.description: Required. Human-facing docs for the skill, linked from the root README table.

VERSION.description: Required. A single semver line (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH[-prerelease][+build]), no leading 'v'.

scripts.description: Optional. Deterministic CLI helpers. Python 3 stdlib only, no third-party deps.

templates.description: Optional. Files the skill's scripts copy into a target project.

references.description: Optional. Long-form docs the skill loads on demand.

hooks.description: Optional. Lifecycle hook scripts installed alongside the skill.

commands.description: Optional. Slash commands live at repo root in commands/<dir>/ and must all be *.md; Claude Code loads them as /<dir>:<file>, the installer also ships flat /<dir>-<file> aliases.
